observations.trace: LayerSelection admits item and placement through the catalogue, retains a CatalogPlacement, and implements equality, hashing and ordering using the exact item/placement text pair. Its OutfitPlan sorts and deduplicates that pair before building the layer graph. CatalogPlacement itself uses pointer identity for equality and hash and has no lexical ordering. Deriving the wrapper traits from its field would change the recorded identity/ordering policy; native text keys at this lexical boundary are not automatically a bespoke-type defect.
observations.remaining: Catalogue uniqueness, duplicate-ID policy in every producer and all consumer equivalence constraints need independent audit; this observation does not clear all string, owner or derivability lenses.

observations.trace: LayerPlan checks contradictory precedence and fails if no acyclic next node exists. FitKey reconstructs each support key with its own full ancestor list; next_fit prepares missing inner supports first and propagates stored support failure. Cache trim retains fitted bodies referenced by cached models or the pending fit.
observations.remaining: The source describes intended control flow only; no generated fit, task scheduling, GPU, eviction or failure behavior was executed. Complete concurrency, invalidation, support graph and exact aliases remain open.

observations.trace: The normal canonical body builder derives its surface chart from positions and rejects a nonfinite or nonpositive height, which includes the empty-position case. BodyShapeKey::apply later uses the position count for target dimensions and target chunks. This inspected builder narrows a zero-chunk concern for its admitted loaded body.
observations.remaining: Test-only source constructs an empty synthetic body, and other constructors/callers, complete morph dimension limits, normal cardinality and native asset states remain independently open; no fixture was run.
